question: Materialize the unchanged proposal, mask and descriptor roster for a wholly fresh three-reference family with two adjacent queries, before applying the frozen calibrated depth-pose propagation rule.

predecessor.single_change: Transport the frozen depth-pose proposal rule unchanged to a wholly fresh family: select the adjacent query candidate with greatest preserved-contributor agreement, estimate its median metric depth from official depth pixels inside the box, and reproject its four corners through official camera poses into the other frame.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among three target references; normalized foreground patches from DINOv2 ViT-L/14 zero-based block 18 supply query-directed local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches.
frozen_confirmation_rule: preserve layer-18 local minus 0.05 times distance to the nearest of three reference target log-area fractions
preserve best fusion constrained to the plurality winning target reference across the adjacent pair

select the exact-deduplicated candidate with greatest contributor agreement and reproject its four corners at median official depth through official camera poses into the other frame only when a set vacancy exists

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; confirmation coverage is evaluated only after preserved contributor deduplication and the frozen depth-pose vacancy rule completes.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after contributor agreement, anchor choice, median depth, pose transform, projected rectangle and bounded set are complete.

literature_motivation.source: Seeing Behind Objects for 3D Multi-Object Tracking in RGB-D Sequences
literature_motivation.use: Motivates backprojecting RGB-D observations and using 3D geometry and correspondences to persist object evidence across changing views.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the five frozen images, candidate roster, model bytes, features, preserved contributors, anchor agreement, median depth, pose convention, four-corner projection, zero padding, clipping, vacancy condition, set size three or IoU gate
use query truth before the complete set is fixed
retry, rescue or retune this fresh family after the confirmation result is materialized
claim_boundary: This artifact freezes only the fresh proposal and descriptor roster. It cannot by itself establish depth-pose propagation, whole-rule confirmation, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, portal ownership, affordance, access, safety, waypoint, arrival or handoff.
